notes.content: Footer Branding Policy: Core UI footer MUST ONLY state Powered by Breaking Into Cybersecurity with link to breakingintocybersecurity.org. Secondary resources belong in the Resources & Citations modal.

Session Storage Policy: Authenticated Google SSO users save conversation history to Cloud Firestore. Temporary screen names run in Guest Mode (no Firestore history saved across sessions, ACE memory operates in-memory).
